model_key: your model API key, or with model_access.auth: oauth a subscription token
github_app_key: -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----- your GitHub App's private key -----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
api_token: a long random token for automation; deploy/k3d/up.sh makes one if you leave it out
payload_key: 32 random bytes in base64 (openssl rand -base64 32); deploy/k3d/up.sh makes one if you leave it out
step_token_key: a long random key; deploy/k3d/up.sh makes one if you leave it out
object_store_access_key: made by deploy/k3d/up.sh in k3d; not needed on AWS
object_store_secret_key: made by deploy/k3d/up.sh in k3d; not needed on AWS
